name: Fernandez Bay Village
primary_cta: Check availability (innRoad), in the film letterbox for the whole film
brand_truth: A family-run village of cottages in Fernandez Bay, Cat Island, where every room looks at the beach and the day ends at a bonfire on the sand.
buyer: US couples 40-70, families and groups of friends, private pilots; planning on a phone, comparing small Out Island resorts.

direction.why: Their professional 2500 px photography carries a film of one day in the bay; the letterbox bar holds subtitles of real facts and the booking button for the whole film. Pine only for the top letterbox bar and the Getting here band; the page is pale sea-grape paper.

tier_why: Their photography as scroll-scrubbed film with slow Ken Burns; no 3D needed.
concept_type: booking: cottages and villas handing off to innRoad, WhatsApp enquiry
